_comment_top: R6 Pillar 6b / D-C-05 / task 054 — seed row for the SendWorkspaceArtifactHandler chat tool. AIR2-075 (2026-07-10): the legacy artifact variants (Summary/DocumentViewer/Dashboard/Table) + the IWorkspaceStateService write path were retired. Surfaces a single LLM-visible 'send_workspace_artifact(widgetType, title, widgetData)' function whose only widgetType is 'Workspace' — it opens a named workspace LAYOUT (e.g. Compose) as a live tab via a workspace_open_tab SSE frame the client materializes.
_comment_routing: Runtime invocation routes to the C# class via sprk_handlerclass = 'SendWorkspaceArtifactHandler' (= nameof handler class). Auto-discovered via ToolFrameworkExtensions.AddToolHandlersFromAssembly (ADR-010) — ZERO new top-level DI line.
_comment_placement_boundary: ADR-013 binding: the Workspace layout-tab open uses the SSE writer + WorkspaceLayoutService + IUiActionAckCoordinator — BFF-internal chat-session plumbing, NOT an AI-internal seam behind a PublicContracts facade. The Compose pre-seed Dataverse read runs under the calling user's OBO token (IDataverseUserClient).
_comment_security: sprk_requiredcapability = null (intentional). Opening a workspace layout tab is a default user affordance — every chat session, standalone or playbook-bound, can open a tab. The single 'Workspace' widgetType is the authorization surface — there is no 'free text widget' escape hatch.
_comment_tenant_isolation: ADR-014 binding: the chat session's TenantId is required on the invocation context; the Compose pre-seed Dataverse read runs under the calling user's OBO token so cross-tenant access is structurally impossible.
_comment_adr015: ADR-015 data governance: telemetry logs handler name + decision GUID + tabId GUID + widgetType discriminator + title LENGTH + duration ONLY. NEVER the LLM-supplied widgetData body content; NEVER the title text; NEVER the user's chat message. Layout/document identifiers are logged as flags or GUIDs, never file names.
_comment_description_loadbearing: sprk_description is LOAD-BEARING per NFR-12: the LLM uses the description text to decide WHEN to invoke this tool. The description describes the 'Workspace' layout-tab variant (materialized live via the workspace_open_tab SSE frame → PaneEventBus workspace.widget_load bridge). G-P3 UAT round-4 R4-2 (2026-07-07): the Compose document PRE-SEED contract — optional widgetData.documentId (sprk_document GUID) resolves server-side (user-OBO) to its SPE drive-item pointer and rides the widgetData as a 'compose' seed the SpaarkeAi host threads into ComposeLaunchContext. spaarkeai-compose-r2 FR-03 (task 012, 2026-07-09): widgetData.sessionFileId — a chat-session UPLOADED file id whose retained bytes (ITenantCache 'doc-upload-binary', from ChatDocumentEndpoints step 9b) are served by POST /api/compose/upload and mounted into the Compose editor as a TRANSIENT working draft (create-on-save; no sprk_document until first Save). Rides widgetData as 'compose.upload' {sessionId, sessionFileId}; documentId (stored) and sessionFileId (upload) are mutually exclusive. AIR2-075 (2026-07-10): the legacy artifact variants were retired.
_comment_consumption: Read by scripts/Seed-TypedHandlers.ps1. Idempotent — script queries by sprk_handlerclass + sprk_toolcode with sprk_name 'SYS-%' filter; UPSERTs.
sprk_description: Open a tab in the user's workspace pane. PREFERRED USE — open a named workspace LAYOUT as a live tab: widgetType 'Workspace' with widgetData {"kind":"Workspace","layoutName":"<layout name>"}. Use layoutName 'Compose' when the user asks to open the Compose editor or to start composing/drafting a document in the workspace; other layouts (e.g. 'Daily Briefing', 'Documents') open the same way. When opening the Compose layout ABOUT A SPECIFIC DOCUMENT, add widgetData.documentId (the sprk_document GUID, e.g. from a search result path tables/sprk_document/records/{guid}) — Compose then opens WITH that document loaded. To open a file the user UPLOADED into this chat, add widgetData.sessionFileId (the uploaded file's id from the session's attachments) instead of documentId — Compose opens with that file mounted as a transient working draft (no document record is created until the user saves). Use documentId for stored sprk_document records and sessionFileId for session uploads; set at most one. If the requested layout does not exist, the tool result lists the available layout names — relay them honestly. The tab opens immediately in the workspace pane and the tool result confirms it; only claim a tab was opened when this tool result says so.
_comment_availableincontexts: 100000001 = Chat only. Workspace tab dispatch is a chat-surface affordance — playbook nodes write to sprk_analysisoutput + sprk_workingdocument, not the chat-session per-tenant workspace tab list. Future R7+ work MAY extend this to Both (100000002) if cross-context artifact dispatch becomes a coherent flow.

sprk_jsonschema.title: SendWorkspaceArtifactHandler Request
sprk_jsonschema.description: Argument shape for chat-driven invocation of the send_workspace_artifact tool. widgetType 'Workspace' opens a named workspace layout as a live tab (emits the workspace_open_tab SSE frame the client materializes). The legacy artifact variants (Summary/DocumentViewer/Dashboard/Table) were retired by AIR2-075.

widgetType.description: Closed enum. 'Workspace' opens a named workspace layout as a live tab. The 'widgetData.kind' field MUST equal this value.

title.description: Display title for the workspace tab — shown on the tab strip and in tooltips. For 'Workspace', use the layout name (e.g. 'Compose'). NEVER raw user message text — author a concise headline.

documentId.description: Optional (Workspace variant only): sprk_document GUID to pre-seed the Compose layout with a STORED document — Compose opens WITH that document loaded. MUST be a real sprk_document row id (e.g. from tables/sprk_document/records/{guid} citation paths). For a file the user uploaded into this chat, use sessionFileId instead. Set at most one of documentId / sessionFileId.

sessionFileId.description: Optional (Workspace variant only): the id of a file the user UPLOADED into this chat session. Compose mounts its retained bytes as a transient working draft (create-on-save — no document record until the user saves). Set at most one of documentId / sessionFileId.

widgetData.description: Workspace payload: requires {layoutName} (the layout's display name, e.g. 'Compose') or {layoutId} (GUID); optional {documentId} (sprk_document GUID) pre-seeds the Compose layout with a stored document, OR {sessionFileId} mounts a session-uploaded file transiently. Deterministic identifiers + display metadata only — ADR-015 binding: NEVER raw user message text.

sprk_configuration._comment: No method-discriminator dispatch — this row exposes a single LLM-facing function. Empty object reserved for future per-row defaults (e.g., default widget-type override, per-tenant 'always-pin' policy).
sprk_configuration._comment_riskprofile: Confirmation Policy v2 (FR-A1-03, task 032) catalog-declared risk factors — DATA extending sprk_sideeffectclass per policy-v2-origin-classification-decision-tree.md §1. Opening a workspace tab is a private, fully-reversible UI affordance (the user can close it) with no system-of-record mutation ⇒ Tier 2a (private/internal reversible; ✅ card + Undo when explicit+complete). Consumed by GateRiskProfile.FromConfiguration + RiskTierResolver; NEVER a runtime model judgment.
